location_note: Map reference is for Murabba'at Caves I-III (NIG). Wadi Murabba'at (Nahal Darga), northern bank, about 2 km west of the Dead Sea. Not a held cave area (17 km south of Kh. Qumran).
notes: Survey 2020 and salvage excavation 2022 of Cave II (Permit 06-03-2022). Other finds of the 2022 excavation are left to future publications (n. 4). Bar Kokhba documents and refugee use are from the 1952 excavation (cited, not coded). Hoard deposition: latest coin 171/170 BCE or slightly later, set by the authors in the Sixth Syrian War or the first years of the Maccabean Revolt; coded unknown (NOTES, choice C3).

features.quote: a hoard of 15 Ptolemaic silver coins was discovered

report_zone: multi-site (sites in Z3 and outside the region)
location_note: Synthesis of the author's southern Samaria survey (Tavger 2018 dissertation); 28 sites with ITM (NIG) references in Appendix 1. Six desert-fringe and central-range sites fall in Z3 (north box); the rest are outside the region and not coded.
notes: Bell-shaped pits are interpreted as wineries (unplastered, not for water) and are coded rockcut_installation, not cistern (NOTES, choice C4). Out-of-region sites (for example Shillo, Kh. esh-Shuna, Beit 'Iweis, 'Ein es-Sawiya, Kh. Nabbuh, Migdalim South, esh-Sheikh Mazar, Kh. el-Qariq) are outside every zone box and are not coded. Shillo bell-shaped pits are from the 1926 Danish excavation (cited).
